securityDiagnosticsIntro: Optional checks of the private backend location. Findings do not block the application; the administrator decides how to address them.
securityCheckFailed: The check failed. Verify your author session and API availability.
securityPlacement_within-public-app: Warning: located inside this application's public directory.
securityPlacement_within-inferred-site-r: Warning: located inside the site's inferred web-served directory.
securityPlacement_outside-inferred-site-: Outside the site's inferred public directory.
securityPlacement_unverified: Unable to verify the directory layout.
securityApacheRulePresent: A deny directive was found (its effectiveness is not verified).
securityApacheRuleMissing: No recognizable deny directive or .htaccess was found.
securityProbeMissing: Missing. Upload security-probe.txt from the deployment package for the HTTP test.
securityInconclusive: These checks cannot prove complete security. Apache may have aliases or may ignore .htaccess.
securityProbeUrl: Path to the probe file on this domain
securityProbeExplanation: Enter a path only if you know it. It must start with / and end in /security-probe.txt. Example: /backend/security-probe.txt. Example text is not a prefilled value.
securityProbe_exposed: RISK: the test file is publicly accessible. Protect the backend.
securityProbe_blocked: This specific URL did not serve the file (HTTP 403 or 404). Other URLs may still expose it.
securityProbe_unverified: Inconclusive: the server neither served the expected file nor unambiguously denied access.
securityProbe_invalid: Invalid path. Enter a same-origin path starting with / and ending in /security-probe.txt, without parameters or ../.
securityOverviewGood: The backend and private data appear to be placed appropriately.
securityOverviewDanger: Warning: some private files are located inside the application's public directory.
securityOverviewWarning: Security is inconclusive or the directory layout needs further checking.
securityOverviewExposed: Confirmed exposure: the probe file is accessible over HTTP.
securityOverviewNote: This is advisory only. It cannot detect every web-server alias or later configuration change.
securityAdvancedHttpTitle: Advanced: test a specific HTTP URL (optional)
securityAdvancedHttpIntro: If you know a URL that might expose the backend, you can test whether the server serves its harmless probe file. This is optional and cannot prove that all paths are protected.
securityNoSuggestedUrl: The backend is outside the inferred web root, so the application cannot infer any public URL for it. Leave this empty if you do not know one.
securitySuggestedUrl: The application derived this possible URL from the backend location. You can keep or change it:
